body:
Compared the default Rust CLI runtime with a single-thread prototype in two quiet release series on M4/macOS 27. Complete-process help, hello, Focus preview/snapshot, current source and explicit project-context medians improve by only 0.09–0.16 ms. All 2,400 selected observations retain native result, identity and source-version checks. The prototype is rejected and the source restored exactly; no perceptible application benefit is claimed.

Documentation/package validation passes. The existing verified application/manual instance remains unchanged, with no new full-gate/browser/device or deployment claim. The owner card edit is preserved. Current source pin discovery retains all parsed card bodies before selecting references; that temporary memory cost is the next measured investigation. Broader performance and release acceptance remain open.

metadata.summary: CLI runtime startup probe rejected after matched release measurements
